notes.title: iOS version released
notes.notes:
We have just released Royal Bounty HD for iOS. A universal app supports all iphones and ipads, excluding iPad mini 1, iPad 1, and iPad 2, as well as iPhone 3S, 3GS, and 4.

https://itunes.apple.com/app/royal-bounty-hd/id930361943?mt=8

notes.title: Bugfixes and new languages for you!
notes.notes:
We are continuing to improve the game for you. 
*New game translations have been added
*Hero movement improved
*Fixed steam achievements for completing the game on Normal, or Easy
*AI now uses the wait turn button correctly in combat
*Fixed a serious issue with quest completion
*Autocombat could crash at certain moment. Fixed.
*You can now send us crash reports, game logs, and saves with one click from the game settings.

Looking forward to more feedback from you to polish the game to perfection. Rock on!

notes.title: Android Version
notes.notes:
Royal Bounty HD is now available on Google Play in "beta" mode. The game is complete, but may work unstable on some Android devices, so we decided to put it into "open beta" mode first to check how it works on a variety of devices.
You can access it using this special link only (it's not publicly live in the store yet): https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.palmheroes.royalbounty_hd

notes.title: A Big Update!
notes.notes:
A big update comes to those who wait for it!

*Please note that some of those improvement will only work when you start a new game!


Korean, German, Polish, Brazilian translations
all-new spellbook layout
improved game performance during enemy turn
fixed growth rate of treasuries
War Academy now accessible earlier in the game
even more variety in neutral creature types
lots, lots of crashes fixed
creatures grow slower on Easy difficulty
fixed some achievements
Alt+Enter support for Windows
Alt+F4 fixed for Windows
You can now send us your saves and logs to report a problem (button is available in game settings) 
new fog of war
animated morale and luck in combat
combat field of view now dragable and zoomable with ctrl-/+
creature info now accessible by clicking on combat sequence
improved quick combat
under the hood loading speed optimization

notes.title: A minor update
notes.notes:
We have just uploaded an update:
* Updated game translations. Languages affected the most are Polish, and German
* Gameplay is now localized into German. 

Enjoy! If you like the game so far, don't forget to leave a review, and also visit our official Steam Community (warning: trolls and spoilers, don't forget to take your Spiked Club of Justice with you!)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/337210
